28#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
29pub struct Destination {
30    map: IndexMap<Vec<u8>, Object>,
31}
32
33#[allow(dead_code)]
34impl Destination {
35    pub fn new(title: Object, page: Object, typ: Object) -> Self {
36        let mut map = IndexMap::new();
37        map.insert(b"Title".to_vec(), title);
38        map.insert(b"Page".to_vec(), page);
39        map.insert(b"Type".to_vec(), typ);
40        Destination { map }
41    }
42
43    pub fn set(&mut self, key: Vec<u8>, value: Object) {
44        self.map.insert(key, value);
45    }
46
47    pub fn title(&self) -> Option<&Object> {
48        self.map.get(b"Title".as_slice())
49    }
50
51    pub fn page(&self) -> Option<&Object> {
52        self.map.get(b"Page".as_slice())
53    }
54}

56type OutlinePageIds = Vec<(Vec<u8>, ObjectId, usize)>;
57
58fn setup_outline_page_ids<'a>(outlines: &'a Vec<Outline>, result: &mut OutlinePageIds, level: usize) -> Result<&'a Vec<Outline>> {
59    for outline in outlines.iter() {
60        match outline {
61            Outline::Destination(destination) => {
62                result.push((destination.title()?.as_str()?.to_vec(), destination.page()?.as_reference()?, level));
63            }
64            Outline::SubOutlines(sub_outlines) => {
65                setup_outline_page_ids(sub_outlines, result, level + 1)?;
66            }
67        }
68    }
69    Ok(outlines)
70}
71
72impl Document {
73    fn setup_page_id_to_num(&self) -> IndexMap<(u32, u16), u32> {
74        let mut result = IndexMap::new();
75        for (page_num, page_id) in self.get_pages() {
76            result.insert(page_id, page_num);
77        }
78        result
79    }
80
81    pub fn get_toc(&self) -> Result<Toc> {
82        let mut toc: Toc = Toc { toc: Vec::new(), errors: Vec::new() };
83        let mut named_destinations = IndexMap::new();
84
85        let Some(outlines) = self.get_outlines(None, None, &mut named_destinations)? else {
86            return Err(Error::NoOutline);
87        };
88
89        let mut outline_page_ids = Vec::new();
90        setup_outline_page_ids(&outlines, &mut outline_page_ids, 1)?;
91        let page_id_to_page_numbers = self.setup_page_id_to_num();
92        for (title, page_id, level) in outline_page_ids {
93            if let Some(page_num) = page_id_to_page_numbers.get(&page_id) {
94                let s = if title.len() < 2 {
95                    String::from_utf8_lossy(&title).to_string()
96                } else if title[0] == 0xfe && title[1] == 0xff {
97                    if title.len() & 1 != 0 {
98                        toc.errors.push(format!("Title encoded UTF16_BE {title:?} has invalid length!"));
99                        continue;
100                    }
101                    let t16: Vec<u16> = title.chunks(2).skip(1).map(|x| ((x[0] as u16) << 8) | x[1] as u16).collect();
102                    String::from_utf16_lossy(&t16)
103                } else if title[0] == 0xff && title[1] == 0xfe {
104                    if title.len() & 1 != 0 {
105                        toc.errors.push(format!("Title encoded UTF16_LE {title:?} has invalid length!"));
106                        continue;
107                    }
108                    let t16: Vec<u16> = title.chunks(2).skip(1).map(|x| ((x[1] as u16) << 8) | x[0] as u16).collect();
109                    String::from_utf16_lossy(&t16)
110                } else {
111                    String::from_utf8_lossy(&title).to_string()
112                };
113                toc.toc.push(TocType { level, title: s, page: *page_num as usize });
114            }
115        }
116        Ok(toc)
117    }
118}

125    fn parse_toc() {

128            TocType { level: 2, title: String::from("1.1. Stone Fruits"), page: 2 },

130            TocType { level: 3, title: String::from("1.1.2. Plums"), page: 6 },
131            TocType { level: 2, title: String::from("1.2. Pomes"), page: 28 },
132            TocType { level: 3, title: String::from("1.2.1. Apples"), page: 30 },
133            TocType { level: 3, title: String::from("1.2.2. Pears"), page: 35 },
134            TocType { level: 2, title: String::from("Summary"), page: 36 },
135            TocType { level: 1, title: String::from("2. Berries & Hesperidia"), page: 40 },
136            TocType { level: 2, title: String::from("2.1. True Berries"), page: 40 },
137            TocType { level: 2, title: String::from("Summary"), page: 41 },
138            TocType { level: 1, title: String::from("3. The End"), page: 100 },
139        ];
140
141        let doc = Document::load("assets/test.pdf").unwrap();
142        let toc = doc.get_toc().unwrap();
143        assert_eq!(toc.toc, expected);
144    }
